note: Triennial election of Antrim Rural District Council (and Guardians); nominations received on Wednesday 3 May 1939 by Mr. James L. Clark, M.B.E., clerk and returning officer: 'There will be no contests' (Ballymena Observer, 5 May 1939, p. 10). Twenty divisions returned their only nominees (Antrim Urban two members); in Ballynadrenta, Ballyrobin, Dunadry and Seacash no nomination was received and the retiring members were deemed re-elected. No party labels are printed. The statutory polling day for Co. Antrim was Thursday 1 June 1939 (no poll in this district); filed under 1939-06-01 (renamed from 1939-05-31, gap-fill 6 Nov 2026). Returned unopposed.
